# GENERATED — do not edit here

Everything in this directory, and the sibling `opencode.jsonc`, is compiled
from the tooter workbench repo (`~/dev/src/github/tooter`, sources under
`tutor/`). Edit the sources there and run `just deploy`; direct edits here are
overwritten on the next deploy and flagged by `just deploy --check`.

Exceptions: `node_modules/`, `package.json`, `package-lock.json`, `bun.lock`,
and `.gitignore` in this directory are opencode's own runtime scaffolding —
untracked and not managed by the deploy.
